text:
Marta (Partnerships): quick sync — kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding focused on billing/entitlement mappings across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: align trial coupons, metered billing IDs, and bundle SKUs with legal packaging. Small thread to capture owners.
Kevin (PM): timeline? we need GA-ready assets by EOD next Tue to hit marketplace window.
Marta (Partnerships): target = next Tue. First step: confirm billing dimensions and trial coupon formats per provider. Kevin -> you own mapping doc. Liz -> integration matrix for meter types.
Liz (Engineered Integrations): on it. will send a short matrix w/ meter id examples. question: do we use provider-managed trials or redeemable coupon codes?
Omar (Finance): prefer provider-managed for easier reconciliation but some partners require coupon redemption. need mapping for both.
Anna (Legal): packaging constraints: can't call product 'enterprise' in listing; must include data residency notice for EU regions. Also need trial terms text — send draft.
Kevin (PM): action items: 1) Liz create meter-id matrix by Fri noon. 2) Omar produce reconciliation flow + accounting impacts by Fri EOD. 3) Anna draft marketplace trial T&Cs by Mon. Marta to compile assets and submit.
Liz (Engineered Integrations): sharing early draft: https://rbw.io/marketplace/meter-matrix (internal). sample snippet:
```
provider: aws
meter_type: usage-based
meter_id: redwood.inference.token
billing_unit: tokens
```
Marta (Partnerships): nice. Liz, include edge case rows for 'trial followed by subscription' and 'metered during trial' — providers handle differently.
Omar (Finance): FYI: for Azure marketplace metered billing we need a monthly usage report -> format: CSV with header `resourceId,usageQuantity,usageDate`.
Anna (Legal): drafted trial paragraph, small change suggested:
"Trial access limited to 30 days; usage beyond trial billed per standard pricing. Trial redeemables are single-use and cannot be stacked."
Kevin (PM): can someone volunteer to test redeemable coupon flow on GCP sandbox before submit?
Liz (Engineered Integrations): I'll run GCP sandbox test Tuesday morning.
Marta (Partnerships): thanks. I'll schedule a 30m sync Monday 9am PT to review artifacts. Please add any blockers here.
deploy-bot: submission checklist created for marketplace-2729. Items: license, trial-terms, meter-matrix, legal-approved-copy, screenshots.
Omar (Finance): blocker: need final tax classification for EU sales. pinging tax ops.
Marta (Partnerships): noted. tagging @tax-ops to confirm EU VAT handling :pray:
Kevin (PM): cool — if no major blockers, we'll submit Wed afternoon to get vendor review before window.
Liz (Engineered Integrations): adding test notes to the matrix. will post results here.
Anna (Legal): uploaded final copy to Drive: https://drive.redwood/legal/marketplace/trial-terms_v2.docx
Marta (Partnerships): great work team :thumbsup:
